sections.Profile:
"Just 21" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in January 1950. Designed by Harry Mabs, the game features two flippers, four passive bumpers, and ten standup targets. A notable feature is the turret shooter, which allows players to aim and launch the ball from between the flippers, adding a unique skill element to the gameplay.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1950

- Type: Electro-Mechanical
